firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: 中国联通廊坊智·云数据中心; existing operational facilities
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The named participant tells the reporter that the centre has already commissioned 18,600 racks (已投产1.86万架机柜). His separate description of starting a new generation of three computing buildings does not establish those buildings as operating or confirm a physical construction stage.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: September 14 is the original CS field-report publication confirming the reported current state. The visit/interview is described only as recent. No exact interview, commissioning or opening date is supplied.
firsthand_status_statement.review: Explicit named project-participant commissioned-state confirmation in the captured original publisher report. Admit existing facilities only. No exact operating-building list, whole-campus completion, current occupied rack count, start date or expansion power is inferred.

sources.source_projection_review: The same article/capture already has canonical evidence metadata in the fifteenth dataset. All canonical evidence fields, source ID, title and capture pin are retained verbatim. This new action projection selects the separate named Langfang participant statement. The original Wuqing statement remains below and the baseline Wuqing record is unchanged.

other_project_firsthand_status_statement.speaker: 贾晋宁
other_project_firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: 中国电信京津冀智能算力中心相关负责人 (a representative responsible for the named centre; exact job title unspecified)
other_project_firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: 中国电信京津冀智能算力中心 in Tianjin Wuqing
other_project_firsthand_status_statement.statement: The named centre representative describes the existing deployment as serving customers around Beijing and says intelligent-compute demand currently exceeds supply. This supports current operation of existing facilities, without assigning all campus buildings an operational state.
other_project_firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: September 14 is the original China Securities Journal publication confirming the reported present state. The exact visit/interview date is not supplied. The article explicitly places initial resource-pool construction in 2024; that historical year is not the selected confirmation date or a precise opening date.
other_project_firsthand_status_statement.review: Accept only existing operational facilities at the named campus. The named centre representative describes serving customers in the Beijing-surrounding region and current demand exceeding available intelligent-compute supply. This participant statement is distinct from the reporter observation of a control screen displaying power/card use, which corroborates actual operation. Neither statement identifies all operating buildings, proves completion of the whole campus, or completes Phase 4. The 2024 construction sentence alone would be insufficient for current status.
